text: 1. Data sharing and preservation
label: section

text: Data management plans should describe whether and how data generated in the course
label: content

text: of the proposed research will be shared and preserved. If the plan is not to share and/or
label: content

text: preserve certain data, then the plan must explain the basis of the decision (for example,
label: content

text: cost/benefit considerations, other parameters of feasibility, scientific appropriateness, or
label: content

text: limitations discussed in #4). At a minimum, DMPs must describe how data sharing and
label: content

text: preservation will enable validation of results, or how results could be validated if data
label: content

text: are not shared or preserved.
label: content

text: Roles & Responsibilities. For the proposed research, Director Samuel Stupp with help from the
label: section

text: Executive Director of Research will take the lead and responsibility for coordinating and ensuring data
label: content

text: storage and access and communicating expectations to all investigators. However, all senior
label: content

text: investigators will also be involved in managing, storing, and disseminating the results of the project
label: content

text: and will be responsible for checking that the plan is being followed.
label: content

text: Data Types and Sources. A brief, high-level description of the data to be generated or used through
label: section

text: the course of the proposed research and which of these are considered Digital Research Data
label: content

text: necessary to Validate the research findings.
label: content

text: The proposed research in this proposal includes both computational and experimental data that will be
label: content

text: generated at Northwestern University and its five partner institutions (Columbia University, Harvard
label: content

text: University, University of Michigan, and University of Pittsburgh). The computational data includes
label: content

text: coarse-grained and atomistic simulations, finite element analysis, etc., which yield trajectories or
label: content

text: ensembles of configurations. The experimental data is generated by a variety of different sources
label: content

text: include spectroscopy, microscopy, crystallography, magnetic measurements, and X-ray scattering (from
label: content

text: the Advanced Photon Source at Argonne National Lab).
label: content

text: In most cases, the raw data will be converted to some other format (graph, table, schematic, video, etc.)
label: content

text: prior to use in publications, conference talks, etc.
label: content

text: Content and Format. A statement of plans for data and metadata content and format including, where
label: section

text: applicable, a description of documentation plans, annotation of relevant software, and the rationale for
label: subsection

text: the selection of appropriate standards. (Existing, accepted community standards should be used where
label: content

text: possible. Where community standards are missing or inadequate, the DMP could propose alternate
label: content

text: strategies that facilitate data sharing, and should advise the sponsoring program of any need to
label: content

text: develop or generalize standards.)
label: content

text: Data are output from the various instruments in lab in formats, which are occasionally proprietary.
label: content

text: When possible, the data are converted to comma delimited or other universally accessible formats. If
label: content

text: the format is not comma delimited, all instruments can export into a format compatible with common
label: content

text: software such as Microsoft Excel, OriginPro, Shelx, etc. Files are typically stored electronically on
label: content

text: group servers with file names that are related to lab notebook pages. Data sharing and preservation will
label: content

text: enable validation of results by enabling students to repeat synthetic preps and data analysis. Every
label: content

text: piece of data fitting including the equations used to fit the data are backed up on local group servers or
label: content

text: to secure cloud services. This enables validation through equation checking, reproducing data and
label: content

text: analyses. Binary data files will be accompanied by a text file describing their content and by source
label: content

text: code for reading the binary format. The video will be encoded following standard conventions readable
label: content

text: by the majority of widely and freely available video decoding programs. Lossless compression of the
label: content

text: data files may be performed on large data sets.
label: content

text: Public talks and outreach activities will generate audio and video files (.mpeg, .avi etc) and is expected
label: content

text: to be less than XX GB. Experimental techniques will generate text and Microsoft Office files and
label: content

text: videos that are expected to be less than XX GB.

text: Data Sharing and Data Preservation. A description of the plans for data sharing and preservation.
label: section

text: This should include, where appropriate:
label: content

text: the anticipated means for sharing and rationale for any restrictions on who may access the data
label: content

text: and under what conditions;
label: content

text: a timeline for sharing and preservation that addresses both the minimum length of time the data
label: content

text: will be available and any anticipated delay to data access after research findings are published;
label: content

text: any special requirements for data sharing, for example, proprietary software needed to access
label: content

text: or interpret data, applicable policies, provisions, and licenses for re-use and re-distribution, and
label: content

text: for the production of derivatives, including guidance for how data and data products should be
label: content

text: cited;
label: content

text: any resources and capabilities (equipment, connections, systems, software, expertise, etc.)
label: content

text: requested in the research proposal that are needed to meet the stated goals for sharing and
label: content

text: preservation. (This could reference the relevant section of the associated research proposal and
label: content

text: budget request);
label: content

text: cost/benefit considerations to support whether/where the data will be preserved after direct
label: content

text: project funding ends and any plans for the transfer of responsibilities for sharing and
label: content

text: preservation;
label: content

text: whether, when, or under what conditions the management responsibility for the research data
label: content

text: will be transferred to a third party (e.g. institutional, or community repository);
label: content

text: any future decision points regarding the management of the research data including plans to
label: content

text: reevaluate the costs and benefits of data sharing and preservation.
label: content

text: All data pertaining to any published work will be made available to any person on request. Numerical
label: content

text: published data as well as the original raw data files will be freely accessible either as supplementary
label: content

text: data files included with published papers, or as files posted on the web sites of the laboratories in the
label: content

text: Center. Additional data or programs required by third parties will be provided on request. Data that
label: content

text: may support intellectual property claims will be published only after we seek advice from the
label: content

text: Northwestern Innovation and New Ventures Office (INVO). Such advice will be sought in a timely
label: content

text: manner. Otherwise, there are no restrictions on who will be allowed to use the data generated after
label: content

text: publishing is complete, provided that the requester acknowledges the original work. A requester can
label: content

text: use data output of our work, provided guidelines by the publisher for use of published data are
label: content

text: followed.
label: content

text: Electronic files are stored on secure servers hosted by the individual research groups and safeguarded
label: content

text: by automated backup systems and/or backups to off-site servers maintained by their institution. We
label: content

text: project that all of these systems will be in place for at least 10 years. All non-electronic data including
label: content

text: detailed experimental procedures and observations are recorded in laboratory notebooks that do not
label: content

text: leave the senior investigator's lab. Data should be accessible to the rest of the laboratory, but access is
label: content

text: typically revoked when junior investigators leave the lab.
label: content

text: Data will also be deposited into Northwestern Libraries’ institutional repository, Arch, upon
label: content

text: publication. https://arch.library.northwestern.edu/ Arch assigns DOIs, making it easy to find the data.
label: content

text: Necessary metadata and other resources to make the data accessible to future users will be submitted.
label: content

text: Arch will preserve the data for future use. External investigators may choose to instead archive their
label: content

text: data with similar repositories provided by the partner institution (such as Academic Commons at
label: content

text: Columbia University, D-Scholarship@Pitt at the University of Pittsburgh, and Harvard University
label: section

text: Archives).
label: content

text: Rationale. A discussion of the rationale or justification for the proposed data management plan
label: section

text: including, for example, the potential impact of the data within the immediate field and in other fields,
label: content

text: and any broader societal impact.
label: content

text: The Department of Energy stipulates in their "Statement on Digital Data Management" that "To the
label: content

text: greatest extent and with the fewest constraints possible, and consistent with the requirements and other
label: content

text: principles of this Statement, data sharing should make digital research data available to and useful for
label: content

text: the scientific community, industry, and the public." The Center will make every effort to comply with
label: content

text: these guidelines.
label: content

text: Data that is not deemed to be useful for a publication may still be archived at the discretion of the
label: content

text: senior investigator overseeing the work, taking into the costs and benefits of doing so.
label: content

text: The data acquired and preserved in the context of this proposal will be further governed by policies of
label: content

text: the Northwestern University and its partner institutions pertaining to intellectual property, record
label: content

text: retention, and data management.
label: content

text: 2. Data used in publications
label: section

text: Data management plans should provide a plan for making all research data displayed in
label: subsection

text: publications resulting from the proposed research open, machine-readable, and digitally
label: content

text: accessible to the public at the time of publication. This includes data that are displayed
label: content

text: in charts, figures, images, etc. In addition, the underlying digital research data used to
label: content

text: generate the displayed data should be made as accessible as possible to the public in
label: content

text: accordance with the Principles published in the DOE Policy for Digital Research Data
label: document_title

text: Management. The published article should indicate how these data can be accessed.
label: section

text: Research conducted within the Center will be published in appropriate scientific journals. The
label: content

text: publisher may restrict the redistribution of that data. When not prohibitively expensive, open access
label: content

text: will be selected. This will be supplemented by publishing the data in a preprint repository such as the
label: content

text: arXiv subsequent to peer-reviewed publication if possible. All publishers we previously worked with
label: content

text: allow arXiv publication or open access, so we do not anticipate a problem. Crystallographic data will
label: content

text: be deposited into the ICSD or the CCDC databases for broad access. Data will also be disseminated
label: content

text: through seminars at conferences and at other academic institutions. Raw data files can be provided to
label: content

text: others upon request, but will be limited to their personal use only and cannot be redistributed without
label: content

text: written consent from the PI.
label: content

text: Access to data and results prior to publication or file for intellectual property is provided to all
label: content

text: personnel involved in the project, after publication or filing for provisional patents, the data will be in
label: content

text: the public domain and any further data will be provided to the community upon request or through
label: content

text: appropriate websites (i.e. lab web sites). All of the fabrication methods, characterization results, and
label: content

text: data acquired through the proposed research towards the development of the bioactive platforms will
label: content

text: be shared with others through publication in conferences and journals.

text: Data Repositories. Senior investigators typically archive relevant data using their own group servers.
label: section

text: Whenever possible, investigators will be encouraged to also copy data to a centralized data server for
label: content

text: CBES investigators. Additionally, researchers can archive data on repositories at their home
label: content

text: institutions. For example, researchers at Northwestern are encouraged to deposit data into
label: content

text: Northwestern Libraries’ institutional repository, Arch, upon publication
label: content

text: (https://arch.library.northwestern.edu/). Arch assigns DOIs, making it easy to find the data. Necessary
label: content

text: metadata and other resources to make the data accessible to future users will be submitted. Arch will
label: content

text: preserve the data for future use.
label: content

text: Data Volume. Generally, the volume of data generated by CBES researchers should not prohibit their
label: section

text: deposition in available repositories. However, in cases where large volumes of data are generated (e.g.,
label: content

text: temperature/time dependent microscopy or X-ray studies), the data may need to be averaged,
label: content

text: condensed, or minimally processed prior to deposition.
